name: MotionCam Tools
creator: MotionCam
description: Mounts .mcraw footage as DNG sequences for Resolve, with GPU preview, proxy mode, per-clip settings and saved sessions. Version 2.0 beta. Windows needs NTFS, ProjectedFS and a Vulkan GPU; macOS uses fuse-t. Companion desktop utility.
display_description: Mounts .mcraw footage as DNG sequences for Resolve, with GPU preview, proxy mode, per-clip settings and saved sessions. Version 2.0 beta. Windows needs NTFS, ProjectedFS and a Vulkan GPU; macOS uses fuse-t. Companion desktop utility.

requirements.dependencies: Windows 10 1809+, NTFS, ProjectedFS and Vulkan-compatible GPU; macOS 12+, Intel or Apple Silicon and fuse-t. Minimum 8 GB RAM.
